```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# 1. Load the marray library to work with 2-channel microarray data
library(marray)

# Load the swirl dataset, which contains expression data for wildtype vs swirl mutant zebrafish
data(swirl)


# 2. Visualize Raw Data for Array 3 (MvA Plot)

# Extract foreground intensities for the red (Cy5) and green (Cy3) channels for Array 3
array3_Cy5 = swirl@maRf[,3]
array3_Cy3 = swirl@maGf[,3]

# Compute M-values (log2 fold-change) and A-values (average log2 intensity)
M_array3 <- log2(array3_Cy5 / array3_Cy3)
A_array3 <- log2(sqrt(array3_Cy5 * array3_Cy3))

# Combine into a data frame for plotting
plot_data_array3 <- data.frame(M = M_array3, A = A_array3)



library(ggplot2)

# Generate the MvA plot to visualize intensity-dependent bias in Array 3
ggplot(plot_data_array3, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "blue") +
labs(title = "MvA Plot for Array 3", x = "Average log-intensity (A)", y = "Log2 fold-change (M)") +
theme_minimal()

# 3. Global Median Normalization

# Calculate the Cy5/Cy3 intensity ratio for global median normalization
ratio_array3 = array3_Cy5 / array3_Cy3

# Compute the median of the ratios to center the M-values
k_array3 = median(ratio_array3)

# Adjust M-values by subtracting the log2 median to normalize Array 3
M_normalised = log2(array3_Cy5) - log2(array3_Cy3) - log2(k_array3)

# 4. Plot MvA After Global Median Normalization

# Combine normalized M-values with A-values for plotting
plot_global_normalised_array3 <- data.frame(M = M_normalised, A = A_array3)

# Generate MvA plot to visualize effect of global median normalization
ggplot(plot_global_normalised_array3, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "red") +
labs(title = "MvA (Normalized) Plot for Array 3", x = "Average log-intensity (A)", y = "Normalized log2 fold-change (M)") +
theme_minimal()

# 5. LOESS Normalization

# Fit a LOWESS curve to capture intensity-dependent bias
lowess_fit = lowess(A_array3, M_array3, f = 2/3)

# Subtract the LOWESS trend from M-values to remove systematic bias
M_lowess = M_array3 - approx(lowess_fit$x, lowess_fit$y, xout = A_array3)$y

# Plot the LOESS-normalized MvA to visualize the correction
plot(A_array3, M_lowess, pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = "green",
xlab = "Average log-intensity (A)", ylab = "LOWESS-normalized M",
main = "MvA Plot After LOWESS Normalization for Array 3")

# 6. Read GenePix Files for Patient Arrays

# Define file paths for two patient samples
file1 = "/Users/gauri1399/Desktop/Classes/Sem3/Gene expression/Lab4/GenePix_files/patient1.gpr"
file2 = "/Users/gauri1399/Desktop/Classes/Sem3/Gene expression/Lab4/GenePix_files/patient2.gpr"

# Read GenePix files into R using read.maimages from the marray package
patient1 = read.maimages(file1, source = "genepix")
patient2 = read.maimages(file2, source = "genepix")

# 7. Normalize Patient Arrays and Plot MvA

# Background correction using normexp method to remove background noise
patient_bgcorrected = backgroundCorrect(patient1, method = "normexp")

# No normalization: preserves original M-values for comparison
MA_patient = normalizeWithinArrays(patient_bgcorrected, method = "none")
plot_patient = data.frame(
  M = as.vector(MA_patient$M),
  A = as.vector(MA_patient$A)
)


p1 <- ggplot(plot_patient, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "yellow") +
labs(title = "MvA Plot (No Normalization)", x = "Average log-intensity (A)", y = "M") +
theme_minimal()

# Print-tip LOESS normalization to correct intensity-dependent and spatial bias
patient_norm_loess <- normalizeWithinArrays(patient_bgcorrected, method = "printtiploess")
plot_patient_loess <- plot_patient_loess <- data.frame(
  M = as.vector(patient_norm_loess$M),
  A = as.vector(patient_norm_loess$A)
)

p2 <- ggplot(plot_patient_loess, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "green") +
labs(title = "Print-tip LOESS Normalized MvA Plot", x = "Average log-intensity (A)", y = "M") +
theme_minimal()

# Print-tip scale normalization using MAD (Median Absolute Deviation)
printer_order = patient_bgcorrected$printer$printtip
M_values = patient_norm_loess$M
M_scaled = M_values

for(group in unique(printer_order)){
idx = which(printer_order == group)
mad_val = mad(M_values[idx])
M_scaled[idx] = M_values[idx] / mad_val
}

patient_norm_scale = patient_norm_loess
patient_norm_scale$M = M_scaled
plot_patient_scale = plot_patient_scale = data.frame(
  M = as.vector(patient_norm_scale$M),
  A = as.vector(patient_norm_scale$A)
)


p3 <- ggplot(plot_patient_scale, aes(x = A, y = M)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "orange") +
labs(title = "Print-tip Scale Normalized MvA Plot", x = "Average log-intensity (A)", y = "M") +
theme_minimal()

# Display all three plots for comparison
library(patchwork)
p1 | p2 | p3


# 8. Create Normalized Data Matrices for Patients

# Background correction
patient1_bgcorrected = backgroundCorrect(patient1, method = "normexp")
patient2_bgcorrected = backgroundCorrect(patient2, method = "normexp")

# Print-tip LOESS normalization
patient1_norm_loess = normalizeWithinArrays(patient1_bgcorrected, method = "printtiploess")
patient2_norm_loess = normalizeWithinArrays(patient2_bgcorrected, method = "printtiploess")

# Extract M-values and probe IDs
M_patient1 = patient1_norm_loess$M
probeId_patient1 = patient1_norm_loess$genes$ID

M_patient2 = patient2_norm_loess$M
probeId_patient2 = patient2_norm_loess$genes$ID

# Combine into data frames with probe IDs as reference
data_patient1 = data.frame(M_patient1, probeId = probeId_patient1)
data_patient2 = data.frame(M_patient2, probeId = probeId_patient2)

# Rename M columns for clarity
colnames(data_patient1)[1] = "M_patient1"
colnames(data_patient2)[1] = "M_patient2"

# Merge patient datasets using probe IDs to create combined data matrix
combined_data = merge(data_patient1, data_patient2, by = "probeId")
head(combined_data)

# 9. Install and Load Required Libraries

# Install Bioconductor and CRAN packages required for Affymetrix analysis
#BiocManager::install(c("affy", "limma", "affyPLM", "affydata"))
#install.packages("fpc")

# Load libraries
library(affy)
library(limma)
library(affyPLM)
library(fpc)

# 10. Read and Normalize Affymetrix HGU133plus Arrays

# Define path to CEL files
dir.path = "/Users/gauri1399/Desktop/Classes/Sem3/Gene expression/Lab4/HGU133plus_files/"
file_names = sort(list.celfiles(path = dir.path, full.names = TRUE))

# Read Affymetrix CEL files into a metadata object
hgu_data = ReadAffy(filenames = file_names, phenoData = NULL)

# Apply background correction using RMA and MAS methods
hgu_data_rma_corrected = bg.correct(hgu_data, method = "rma")
hgu_data_mas_corrected = bg.correct(hgu_data, method = "mas")

# Normalize data using expresso with quantile normalization and median polish summarization
rma_norm_data = expresso(hgu_data_rma_corrected, bg.correct = FALSE,
normalize.method = "quantiles",
summary.method = "medianpolish",
pmcorrect.method = "pmonly")

mas_norm_data = expresso(hgu_data_mas_corrected, bg.correct = FALSE,
normalize.method = "quantiles",
summary.method = "medianpolish",
pmcorrect.method = "mas")

# Convert normalized data into matrices (genes x samples)
rma_matrix = exprs(rma_norm_data)
mas_matrix = exprs(mas_norm_data)

# Print dimensions to verify 54675 probes and 3 arrays
print(dim(rma_matrix))
print(dim(mas_matrix))

# 11. Correlation Analysis of Normalized Affymetrix Arrays

# Compute correlation matrices to evaluate consistency across healthy subjects
rma_corr = cor(rma_matrix)
mas_corr = cor(mas_matrix)

# Print correlation matrices
print("RMA Normalized Data Correlation:")
print(rma_corr)

print("MAS Normalized Data Correlation:")
print(mas_corr)

```
